_meta.purpose: Maps trained-model class IDs (dataset folder names, e.g. "Wheat___Yellow_rust") to verified knowledge entries in diseases.json (e.g. "yellow-rust"). Only add a mapping after checking that the knowledge entry really describes that class.
_meta.rule: Unmapped classes still show the model's prediction, but no treatment or prevention advice — the app says that no verified guidance exists yet. Never invent advice for an unmapped class.
